origin: Frozen before inspecting any residual-study market result. Controls were stated in the prior conversation: MOM20 + VolumeShock20 + AmountShock20.
question: Does Retail Crowding V1 retain held-out linear predictive association after removing the training-period linear projection on medium-horizon reversal and participation shocks?

inference.family: five held-out residual Pearson IC tests, one per horizon

expected_direction: negative residual IC is consistent with incremental crowding/reversal association; opposite sign is reported as opposite evidence, not relabeled.
limitations: Residual IC is linear novelty relative to the specified controls, not causal retail attribution.
Pearson residual IC uses the existing residual_alpha engine; it is not a Rank-IC residual test.
Retrospective listing universe and current qfq publication are not Strict PIT tradability evidence.
No costs, slippage, limit execution, portfolio capacity or real orders.

RC1 is a linear average of z(MOM5), VolumeShock20 and AmountShock20; exact residualization on its exact three components would be algebraically uninformative. MOM20 is deliberately used as the preregistered reversal control.
